description: Revert one of the changes this server applied (budget, bid, status, targeting, schedule, rename) using the change log. An undo is checked like any other change: raising a budget or bid back up stays within the configured limits, and re-enabling shows and limits what would start delivering. Refuses if the field was changed again since, unless force=true. Not for creates, claims or copies. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

force.description: true = undo even if the item changed after the logged change. Use only when you checked it.

name: snap_undo
